title: API Response Showing Missing VisionOS Export Template in Godot Issue
key_points: The issue reports that the Export Template Manager is missing VisionOS in the per-platform download list.
It has been reproducible since PR #117072 refactored the export template downloader to support per-platform individual downloads.
VisionOS should appear in the Export Template Manager alongside iOS, macOS, Android, etc., allowing users to download VisionOS export templates individually.
limitations: The source does not provide information about the current status or resolution of the reported issue.
asserts: VisionOS is missing from the template download list in the Export Template Manager dialog after PR #117072 refactored the export template downloader.
scope: The context of this assertion is limited to the specific issue being reported, concerning the absence of VisionOS export templates in the Godot Export Template Manager.
